name: Chongqing road & bridge co.,ltd
summary: Chongqing Road & Bridge Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise primarily engaged in the management and operation of road and bridge infrastructure. The company's diverse activities also include the construction of roads, bridges, and other urban engineering projects, as well as ventures in real estate development and building construction. Established in 1997, its main office is situated in Chongqing, China.
